name: contract-probe
description: Standalone docs-vs-published contract runner. Consumes ONLY the npm registry at a resolved version — never workspace:/link:/file:. Not a pnpm workspace member (pnpm-workspace.yaml globs packages/* and examples/* only); tools/contract-check.ts installs the packages a run needs into this directory's own node_modules at check time, run then removed. No "type" field, deliberately: run.ts imports sibling tools/*.ts modules that inherit the ROOT package.json's (also typeless, CommonJS-default) module format — mismatching the two here would put run.ts's named imports through CJS/ESM interop and its cjs-module-lexer named-export detection, which is exactly the gap that silently dropped every named export but "default" the one time this was tried.
